scientific_checks.casas_score_ground_truth: Verified against Washington State University clinical scoring protocol (Dawadi et al., 2013): Score 1 denotes independent task completion without human examiner intervention. Score 2 denotes in-person verbal prompt required. Scores 3 and 5 denote step omission or cognitive breakdown.
scientific_checks.anti_leakage_feature_timing: Post-hoc session metrics (total duration_sec, pause_to_duration_ratio, max_pause_sec) are strictly excluded from predictive features to prevent post-outcome leakage. The model operates solely on pre-task activity complexity to establish baseline autonomy priors.
scientific_checks.domain_shift_governance: This model provides an initial baseline prior reflecting physical domestic ADL history. It is explicitly forbidden from overriding active real-time Unity telemetry or forcing assistance during independent digital gameplay.
